name: CSWA 64 (Hubble)
blurb: CSWA 64, an ultra-massive lens galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: cswa64-hubble
story: One of the most massive lens galaxies known, its gravity bends the light of a more distant galaxy behind it into multiple images. Hubble's sharp view lets astronomers weigh the giant and map how its stars are spread.

claims.text: CSWA64 is one of four extremely massive early-type lens galaxies targeted by HST program 15253
These are among the most massive lens galaxies known
The lens produces multiple images of a background source
Hubble imaging is used to measure the lenses' stellar mass distributions and total mass
